## What it is

Couvercle du `boitier_2w`. Impression tête en bas. Une seule vis M3 au centre du carré (même X que l'aimant, Y sur le bloc).

## Design notes

Same plate, three-wall skirt, and M3 clearance (3.4 mm) as `couvercle_4w`, sized to the 30 × 32 mm inner of the two-Wago box. One hole over the square boss centre.

Hold-down: two murets on the box divider lines (separating each end Wago from the middle), plus a front stop bar per bay just past the Wago depth (`wago_y + jeu_wago`). Same height as the jupe. Matches the commercial Wago-lid pattern in the reference photo.

## Don't

- Do not align lid ribs with the floor rails. They face the bay murets and separate the Wagos.
- Do not run the front bar across the middle on 2w: leave the square boss clear; one segment per end bay.
- Do not run a continuous back skirt across the square M3 boss. The pillar is flush with the rim; the jupe must open there or the lid will not close.
- Do not add a second screw hole. The 2w box has one centred boss.
- Same skirt / polish / M3 rules as `couvercle_4w`.

## Changelog

- Back skirt split around the square M3 boss so the lid nests over the pillar.
- Hold-down murets on divider lines + per-bay front stop (reference Wago lid).
- New lid for `boitier_2w`.
